sentences.text: The contribution agreement for this $5.3M National Housing Co-Investment Fund recipient carries a null description in the Open Data extract.
The CMHC Departmental Plan describes the National Housing Co-Investment Fund as supporting new construction and major repair of affordable, accessible, and energy-efficient housing.
Briefs in this program corpus typically state unit count, percentage of below-market units, accessibility provisions, and the energy-performance standard targeted.
Comparable filings often reference partnerships with the host municipality and provincial housing authorities.

unverifiable.claim: Unit count, project location, accessibility provisions
unverifiable.rationale: The agreement description is null. CMHC commitment letters for the program typically disclose these fields, but they are not present in the federal open contributions extract for this row.

comparableGrants.description: Construction of 142-unit mixed-income building in Halifax, of which 30% are below-market and 100% meet accessibility design standard.
Federal contribution to non-profit purpose-built rental development in Ottawa with energy-performance commitment 25% above code.
Contribution to Indigenous-led affordable housing project in Vancouver with 60 units, including supportive housing component.
Major-repair contribution to legacy social housing portfolio in Calgary, retrofitting 280 units to current accessibility standard.
Construction of women's transition housing in Winnipeg with 40 units, supportive services on-site.
Federal-provincial partnership project for student housing in Saskatoon with 200-unit purpose-built rental.
Co-Investment Fund contribution to seniors' housing project in Halifax with full accessibility design.
Rapid Housing Initiative contribution to homelessness-prevention housing project in Toronto.
